description: Run a multi-step async JavaScript script in the page: top-level await and return work, with log(...), sleep(ms), waitFor(selector), and a state object that persists across execute calls for the session. One call replaces a chain of act/evaluate round-trips; returns { result, logs, state }.

code.description: Async JavaScript body run in the page; `state`, `log(...)`, `sleep(ms)` and `waitFor(selector, { timeout })` are in scope. Return plain JSON.

timeout_ms.description: Upper bound on the run; clamped to `max_timeout_ms`.

error.description: Exception text when not `ok`. A "context destroyed" error usually means the script navigated; split the script at the navigation.

logs.description: `log(...)` output collected during the run, in order.

state.description: Session state after the run; the next execute call sees this as `state`.
